lessons.title: Polite Requests

items.example: Jag skulle vilja lämna ett meddelande.
items.exampleMeaning: I would like to leave a message.

items.example: Kan du skicka ett meddelande till mig?
items.exampleMeaning: Can you send a message to me?

lessons.tip: Use 'kan du' to make polite requests. It is a common way to ask someone to do something for you.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, of course! What do you need?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Snälla, skicka ett meddelande till mig.
dialogue.meaning: Please, send a message to me.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Of course, I will do that!

scenario.partnerRole: A is a person who needs help with a phone call.
scenario.learnerRole: B is the learner who is helping.
scenario.brief: A asks for help with a phone call. A wants to leave a message and needs B's name. Just ask one question at a time.
scenario.goal: You will help A with the phone call.

lessons.title: Spelling Names

items.exampleMeaning: Can you write down the number?

items.example: Jag är ledsen, jag förstår inte.
items.exampleMeaning: I am sorry, I do not understand.

lessons.tip: When spelling names, it's common to ask 'kan du stava?'. This helps clarify any misunderstandings.

scenario.partnerRole: A is a person who wants to know your name.
scenario.learnerRole: B is the learner giving their name.
scenario.brief: A asks for your name and how to spell it. Answer clearly and politely.
scenario.goal: You will spell your name for A.

lessons.title: Leaving a Message

items.exampleMeaning: I want to leave a message.

items.example: Är det viktigt att de vet?
items.exampleMeaning: Is it important that they know?

lessons.tip: When leaving a message, use 'kan jag lämna ett meddelande?'. This phrase is very useful in phone conversations.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Do you want to leave a message?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ja, jag vill lämna ett meddelande.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I want to leave a message.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ja, det är viktigt att de vet.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, it is important that they know.

scenario.partnerRole: A is a person taking a message.
scenario.learnerRole: B is the learner leaving a message.
scenario.brief: A asks if you want to leave a message. Respond with your message clearly.
scenario.goal: You will leave a message for A.

lessons.title: Taking a Message

items.example: Kan jag ta ett meddelande för dem?
items.exampleMeaning: Can I take a message for them?

items.meaning: I will get back to you
items.exampleMeaning: I will get back to you soon.

items.example: Kan du ge mig ditt nummer?
items.exampleMeaning: Can you give me your number?

lessons.tip: When taking a message, ask 'kan jag ta ett meddelande?'. This shows you are ready to help.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Kan jag ta ett meddelande för dem?
dialogue.meaning: Can I take a message for them?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Kan du ge mig ditt nummer?
dialogue.meaning: Can you give me your number?

scenario.partnerRole: A is a person taking a message.
scenario.learnerRole: B is the learner leaving a message.
scenario.brief: A asks if they can take a message. Respond with your message and your number.
scenario.goal: You will provide a message and your contact information.

lessons.title: Review of Phone Calls and Messages

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, of course! What do you need?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Do you want to leave a message?

dialogue.meaning: Yes, I want to leave a message.

dialogue.speaker: A

scenario.partnerRole: A is a person taking a message.
scenario.learnerRole: B is the learner leaving a message.
scenario.brief: A will ask questions about your name and message. Respond clearly and politely.
scenario.goal: You will practice leaving a message and spelling your name.
